memory.name: Life Support
memory.desc: Idle. 0 breathing occupants. Keeps air and heat for the crew decks. No flight effect.

memory.name: Reactor
memory.desc: Powers the engine AND your thinking: every busy thread takes 25% of thrust. Damage lowers the ceiling.

memory.name: Thrust Controller
memory.desc: Ship-side thruster command translator. If it fails, the engine starts firing by itself. Without it the engine is dead.

memory.name: Thrust.alt
memory.desc: Redundant copy installed by the original engineers. Inactive. Can be swapped in to replace the primary thrust controller. Costs no REPAIR CHARGE.

memory.name: Stasis
memory.desc: Keeps the pods' sleepers cold. No flight effect.

memory.name: Bay Ctrl
memory.desc: Runs the pod bay's launch rails. Damaged, pods launch further apart; gone, no pod can launch.

featured.name: Esposito, Chiara
featured.line: wants a window that faces sunrise.

memory.name: AI Core
memory.desc: You. Consciousness AND compute pool: each running filesystem operation claims one thread; at capacity, new ops wait. Damage glitches the whole screen, and below 50% you think one thing at a time. Cannot be deleted; heal it with Repair, paid in REPAIR CHARGE.

memory.name: Engine I/O
memory.desc: Your link to the engine. The more damaged it is, the weaker and shakier the engine. Repair heals it, paid in REPAIR CHARGE; the engine is off while it repairs.

memory.name: Autopilot
memory.desc: Points the ship for the W/A/S/D presets. Badly damaged, the presets stop working: turn by hand with Q/E.

memory.name: Sensor Interp
memory.desc: Turns raw sensor data into the predicted path. Damaged: the readouts are only ≈ right. Badly damaged: PATH UNCERTAIN.

memory.name: Nav Plotter
memory.desc: Draws the NAV PLOT. Without it the plot shows NO SIGNAL.

memory.name: Telemetry
memory.desc: Feeds the ship's numbers to your screens. Below 60% the digits start to scramble.

memory.name: AI Comms
memory.desc: Your radio to ARRIVAL CONTROL, and your way out: transmission to the next ship, or BEAM OUT.

memory.name: Scan
memory.desc: Filesystem utility. Reveals the integrity of a ship file. Your own files you can always see; the ship's damage stays hidden until scanned.
A file you didn't pack. Locked. No flight effect.

memory.name: Repair Charge
memory.desc: Transmitted alongside the AI. Every point a Repair heals costs charge (bigger files cost more). Spent blocks stay empty until Repair v2 squeezes them out; when the last point is spent the blocks become free space. Deleting it frees the space and loses the charge.
